text:
ConocoPhillips fell 1.7% today as crude oil prices dropped for a second consecutive day on hopes for a diplomatic resolution to the Iran conflict, despite ongoing U.S. military strikes on Iranian targets. Oil-dependent stocks like this one move closely with crude prices, and the market is betting that de-escalation talks will ease supply concerns that have kept prices elevated.

The stock's decline also reflects broader political uncertainty ahead of the midterm elections. A Democratic sweep could tilt energy policy toward renewables and away from traditional oil and gas development, adding another headwind to investor sentiment on fossil fuel producers.
